prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production asset: genuinely transparent RGBA PNG, EXACT NATIVE OUTPUT 3840 x 2160 pixels (4K UHD), landscape 16:9, very high detail. This is a retina-display broken-glass overlay laid over arbitrary live game imagery. Render only microscopic fracture lines in the screen's cover glass, on empty alpha. Orthographic front-on, flat image plane, full-bleed to every edge. The interiors of ALL intact glass fragments must be completely alpha=0, never grey, cloudy, frosted or filled. No large grey wedges. No smoky central patch. No blue/purple iridescent globs. Use extremely crisp thin dark fracture cores paired with narrow silvery-white refractive edges and tiny isolated specular glints, so the fractures remain visible over both light and dark backgrounds. Native 4K precision, mostly 1-4 pixel crack filaments with occasional fine twin edges; natural irregular branching, imperfect intersections, delicate curved stresses. More than 90% of the canvas should be genuinely transparent. The crushed impact pit is tiny, under 2% of canvas width. ONLY cracks, no monitor, bezel, device, scene, checkerboard, shadow backdrop, texture sheet, text or logos. No outer rectangular glass outline. Output at 3840x2160, not 1672x941. Variant A: a blunt impact centered at x=49%, y=55%. A sharply detailed central spiderweb has three irregular broken concentric rings and sixteen asymmetrically branching rays extending to all four edges, with secondary hairline crazing localized around the impact. Believable shattered cover glass, still transparent between every filament.
